assert os.getresuid()==(1000,)*3 and os.getresgid()==(1000,)*3
assert os.getgroups()==[]

for fd in range(3,256):
 try: os.fstat(fd)
 except OSError as e:
  if e.errno!=errno.EBADF: raise
 else: raise RuntimeError("surviving descriptor")
with open('/proc/self/status',encoding='ascii') as f:
 s=dict(line.split(':',1) for line in f if ':' in line)
assert all(int(s[k],16)==0 for k in ('CapInh','CapPrm','CapEff','CapBnd','CapAmb'))
assert s['NoNewPrivs'].strip()=='1'
